cues.en: No. This is not an unusual airlifter version of the Phantom f four. On the contrary, this is a type of flying from which transport aircraft, other than helicopters, are usually excluded.
cues.zh: 不，这不是Phantom F-4的 unusual 运输机版本。恰恰相反，这是运输机（除直升机外）通常被排除在外的一种飞行方式。

cues.en: But the flexibility that carrier borne operations offer depends on regular resupply facilities being available and available without the carrier having to move off station.
cues.zh: 但舰载作战所提供的灵活性，取决于能否获得定期补给设施，且无需航母离开战位。

cues.en: Imagine the benefits then of being able to land a medium sized transport aircraft on a carrier, and of course, take it off again afterwards.
cues.zh: 那么想象一下，能将一架中型运输机降落在航母上，之后当然还能让它再次起飞，这会带来怎样的好处。

cues.en: In the sixties, they did a trial on the USS Forrestal to see if it was feasible to operate the Hercules from a carrier.
cues.zh: 六十年代时，他们在福莱斯特号航母上做了一次试验，想看看 Hercules 运输机在航母上起降是否可行。

cues.en: Bear in mind that the Phantom and most other regular shipborne aircraft need steam catapults to get off and arrestor gear to stop them going off the end when they land. But the Hercules wasn't designed with any of that in mind, and so it had to be able to operate without either catapult or arrestor.
cues.zh: 要知道，像 Phantom 以及大多数常规舰载机，起飞都得靠蒸汽弹射器，降落时也需要阻拦索防止冲出跑道。但 Hercules 在设计时完全没考虑过这些，所以它必须在既没有弹射器也没有阻拦索的情况下完成起降。

cues.en: First of all, they tried a touch and go.
cues.zh: 首先，他们尝试了一次触地复飞。

cues.en: The two navy pilots chosen for the trial, lieutenant commander Stovel and lieutenant Flatley, had never flown a four engined aircraft before,
cues.zh: 被选中参加试验的两名海军飞行员，斯托维尔中校和弗拉特利上尉，此前从未驾驶过四发飞机，

cues.en: but they were able to make the first c one thirty carrier landings after only a short period of training.
cues.zh: 但经过短短一段时间的训练，他们就能完成首次C-130航母降落。

cues.en: They went on to complete 29 touch and go landings and 21 unarrested full stop landings and unassisted takeoffs.
cues.zh: 他们随后完成了29次触地复飞和21次无阻拦全停降落与无辅助起飞。

cues.en: During the trial, the aircraft's gross weight was gradually increased to a 121,000
cues.zh: 试验期间，飞机的总重量逐步增加到121,000

cues.en: pounds, which allowed them to carry in 30,000 pounds of payload, more than 13 tons.
cues.zh: 磅，这使他们能够携带30,000磅的有效载荷，超过13吨。
